$comment: Where things sit on her painting, in its own pixels (her.webp is 853 x 1280). Swap her files in art-src/, run `npm run art`, and adjust these numbers if her composition moves; no code changes needed.

halo.$comment: The ring the cameras ride: an ellipse above her head, one camera per channel. turnSeconds is one full turn. cameraSize scales the drawn cameras (cameraSizePhone on the phone layout, where her painting is small). aimDrop is how far below the ring's centre they point: at her face.

front.$comment: The band of her painting cut out and laid over the wires: her title and the top of her frame.
